scoring: Build tasks: benchmark.py grades (missing schematics score 0). Other tasks: deferred judge verdict. Pending judgments and grading errors excluded from accuracy; mean_grade is netlist-only.

metric_definitions.accuracy: passing / evaluated runs (netlist threshold or judge verdict), including run0 when present
metric_definitions.three_run_rates: complete evaluated triples only; pending/unscored groups excluded
metric_definitions.efficiency: all runs with available metadata; tokens = input + output (cached input not added twice)
